Phillip)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Khadrice Rollins | KRollins@masslive.comFor the second time in three days the Houston Rockets host the Los Angeles Lakers at the Toyota Center in Houston, but on Wednesday, March 18, the game will decide who wins the season series and gets the tiebreaker in the standings.This NBA game is scheduled to start at 9:30 p.m. EDT and will be broadcast on ESPN, ESPN Deportes and Spectrum Sports Network. Fans looking to watch can do so for free by using DIRECTV, which offers a free trial, or FuboTV, which also offers a free trial as well as up to $30 off your first month. SlingTV doesn’t offer a free trial but has promotional offers available for streaming the game. You can stream ESPN Unlimited on your phone, tablet, smart TV or gaming console, and those with DIRECTV, FuboTV or Hulu + Live TV can access ESPN Unlimited through their package.Where to Stream NBA Games TodayStreaming ServiceStarting Monthly PriceFree TrialFree Trial LengthMax DiscountDIRECTV$89.99Yes5 days$40 off first monthFuboTV$55.99Yes5 days$30 off first monthSling TV$45.99NoN/A$30 off first monthESPN$12.99NoN/AN/AOn Monday, the Lakers picked up a 100-92 win to improve to 43-25 and drop the Rockets to 41-26. Luka Doncic had a game-high 36 points while Kevin Durant had 18, being held to 2 in the second half while also getting some key late-game turnovers, finishing with seven giveaways. LeBron James also went for 18, while Austin Reaves chipped in 15 and Marcus Smart went for 11. For Houston, Jabari Smith Jr. had a team-high 22, while Amen Thompson had 19 and 12 rebounds and Reed Sheppard added 11 off the bench. Alperen Sengun missed Monday’s matchup but will be back on the court Wednesday.This is the third and final game between these squads who are only separated by 1.5 games in the standings.
